verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas offers a broad programmatic surface. The documented Editor API covers automating and extending the Editor, including scene manipulation, asset management and custom tools. An official MCP server can modify project data inside an open Editor session, and the docs say the same components and properties are available in the Editor, the engine, React and Web Components. However, no source claims or demonstrates full UI-to-API parity, the REST API is listed as a plan feature, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit or verified claim of full UI/API parity, a documented REST API scope and spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), headless operation that does not need an open Editor session, and independent corroboration of API coverage.
